nodes.asset_description: A solid white rectangle is centered on a black background. The rectangle is uniformly filled and has a uniform thickness.

A light blue beaker with a black rim and handle is tilted against a white background. Inside the beaker, a light blue liquid is visible, marked with small white bubbles. The beaker’s scale is visible, with black lines marking the measurements.
A yellow liquid is contained within a clear tube with a white cap. The tube is angled diagonally against a white background. Six small black dashes are visible along the length of the tube.

A cartoon-style battery with a pink top half and a yellow bottom half is shown at an angle. The top half has a small yellow cap and a black "X" mark. The bottom half has a small white circle with a black minus sign.
A cartoon drawing of a dropper with a pink cap and a light beige barrel containing blue liquid. A single drop of blue liquid is falling from the tip of the dropper. The background is black.

A stylized molecular model depicts a central red sphere with six yellow spheres connected by black lines. The spheres are arranged symmetrically around the central structure. The model is set against a white background.

A pair of light blue-framed safety glasses with a small blue droplet on the bridge rests against a white background. The glasses are angled slightly downward and to the right, with white lines visible on the lenses.
